archetype_rationale: 80% of the role is technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders — driving AI transformation, defining technical approaches with clients' technical teams — with only 20% hands-on build. That client-facing, technical-advisor-plus-builder split is the FDE pattern, not a pure agent-builder or product-builder role.
notes: Despite the FDE framing, the build 20% is deep and modern (multi-agent architectures, RAG, LLM eval, tokenization/context/cost optimization); a strong secondary case exists for agent-builder, but the explicit 80% client-guidance split makes FDE / client-facing the day-to-day reality.
